Q1.en: Divide 3825 by the smallest primes in turn: \(3825 = 3 \times 1275 = 3 \times 3 \times 425 = 3^2 \times 5 \times 85 = 3^2 \times 5 \times 5 \times 17\). So \(3825 = 3^2 \times 5^2 \times 17\), which is the choice \(3^2 \times 5^2 \times 17\).
Q1.hi: 3825 को क्रम से छोटी अभाज्य संख्याओं से भाग देने पर: \(3825 = 3 \times 1275 = 3 \times 3 \times 425 = 3^2 \times 5 \times 85 = 3^2 \times 5 \times 5 \times 17\)। अतः \(3825 = 3^2 \times 5^2 \times 17\), जो विकल्प \(3^2 \times 5^2 \times 17\) है।

Q2.en: By the distance formula, the distance of \((p, q)\) from the origin \((0, 0)\) is \(\sqrt{(p-0)^2 + (q-0)^2} = \sqrt{p^2+q^2}\), which is the choice \(\sqrt{p^2+q^2}\).

Q3.en: Use the identity \(\sec^2\theta = 1 + \tan^2\theta\): \(\sec^2\theta = 1 + \frac{p^2}{q^2} = \frac{p^2+q^2}{q^2}\). Taking the positive root for an acute angle, \(\sec\theta = \frac{\sqrt{p^2+q^2}}{q}\), which is the choice \(\frac{\sqrt{p^2+q^2}}{q}\).
Q3.hi: सर्वसमिका \(\sec^2\theta = 1 + \tan^2\theta\) से: \(\sec^2\theta = 1 + \frac{p^2}{q^2} = \frac{p^2+q^2}{q^2}\)। न्यून कोण के लिए धनात्मक वर्गमूल लेने पर \(\sec\theta = \frac{\sqrt{p^2+q^2}}{q}\), जो विकल्प \(\frac{\sqrt{p^2+q^2}}{q}\) है।

Q4.en: Write \(\sec A\) and \(\tan A\) in terms of sine and cosine: \((\sec A - \tan A)(1 + \sin A) = \frac{1 - \sin A}{\cos A}(1 + \sin A) = \frac{1 - \sin^2 A}{\cos A} = \frac{\cos^2 A}{\cos A} = \cos A\), which is the choice \(\cos A\).
Q4.hi: \(\sec A\) और \(\tan A\) को sine और cosine में लिखने पर: \((\sec A - \tan A)(1 + \sin A) = \frac{1 - \sin A}{\cos A}(1 + \sin A) = \frac{1 - \sin^2 A}{\cos A} = \frac{\cos^2 A}{\cos A} = \cos A\), जो विकल्प \(\cos A\) है।

Q5.en: Compare the ratios of the coefficients: \(\frac{a_1}{a_2} = \frac{5}{3}\), \(\frac{b_1}{b_2} = \frac{8}{24/5} = \frac{40}{24} = \frac{5}{3}\) and \(\frac{c_1}{c_2} = \frac{1}{3/5} = \frac{5}{3}\). All three ratios are equal, so the two lines coincide and the pair has infinitely many solutions, which is the choice infinite.
Q5.hi: गुणांकों के अनुपातों की तुलना करने पर: \(\frac{a_1}{a_2} = \frac{5}{3}\), \(\frac{b_1}{b_2} = \frac{8}{24/5} = \frac{40}{24} = \frac{5}{3}\) तथा \(\frac{c_1}{c_2} = \frac{1}{3/5} = \frac{5}{3}\)। तीनों अनुपात बराबर हैं, अतः दोनों रेखाएँ संपाती हैं और समीकरण युग्म के अपरिमित रूप से अनेक हल हैं, जो विकल्प अपरिमित है।

Q6.en: Here the first term \(a = \frac{3}{2}\) and the common difference \(d = \frac{1}{2} - \frac{3}{2} = -1\). So \(a_{10} = a + 9d = \frac{3}{2} - 9 = -\frac{15}{2}\), which is the choice \(-\frac{15}{2}\).

Q7.en: A die has six equally likely outcomes, and two of them (5 and 6) are greater than 4. So the probability is \(\frac{2}{6} = \frac{1}{3}\), which is the choice \(\frac{1}{3}\).
Q7.hi: पासे के छह समप्रायिक परिणाम होते हैं, जिनमें से दो (5 और 6) 4 से अधिक हैं। अतः प्रायिकता \(\frac{2}{6} = \frac{1}{3}\) है, जो विकल्प \(\frac{1}{3}\) है।

Q8.en: Ramesh winning and Suresh winning are complementary events (one of the two must win the match), so their probabilities add up to 1. The probability that Suresh wins is \(1 - 0.82 = 0.18\), which is the choice 0.18.
Q8.hi: रमेश का जीतना और सुरेश का जीतना पूरक घटनाएँ हैं (दोनों में से कोई एक मैच अवश्य जीतेगा), अतः इनकी प्रायिकताओं का योग 1 है। सुरेश के मैच जीतने की प्रायिकता \(1 - 0.82 = 0.18\) है, जो विकल्प 0.18 है।

Q9.en: In the similar triangles \(ABC\) and \(DEF\), corresponding angles are equal, so \(\angle B = \angle E = 75^\circ\). By the angle sum property, \(\angle C = 180^\circ - 57^\circ - 75^\circ = 48^\circ\), which is the choice \(48^\circ\).
Q9.hi: समरूप त्रिभुजों \(ABC\) और \(DEF\) में संगत कोण बराबर होते हैं, अतः \(\angle B = \angle E = 75^\circ\)। त्रिभुज के कोणों के योग के गुण से \(\angle C = 180^\circ - 57^\circ - 75^\circ = 48^\circ\), जो विकल्प \(48^\circ\) है।

Q10.en: The radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of contact, so \(\angle OMT = \angle ONT = 90^\circ\). The angles of the quadrilateral \(OMTN\) add up to \(360^\circ\), so \(\angle MTN = 360^\circ - 90^\circ - 90^\circ - 110^\circ = 70^\circ\), which is the choice \(70^\circ\).
Q10.hi: स्पर्श बिन्दु पर त्रिज्या स्पर्श रेखा पर लम्ब होती है, अतः \(\angle OMT = \angle ONT = 90^\circ\)। चतुर्भुज \(OMTN\) के कोणों का योग \(360^\circ\) होता है, अतः \(\angle MTN = 360^\circ - 90^\circ - 90^\circ - 110^\circ = 70^\circ\), जो विकल्प \(70^\circ\) है।

Q11.en: Arc length \(l = \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times 2\pi r = \frac{60}{360} \times 2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 21 = \frac{1}{6} \times 132 = 22\) cm, which is the choice 22 cm.
Q11.hi: चाप की लम्बाई \(l = \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times 2\pi r = \frac{60}{360} \times 2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 21 = \frac{1}{6} \times 132 = 22\) सेमी, जो विकल्प 22 सेमी है।

Q12.en: The exposed surfaces are the curved surface of the hemisphere, the curved surface of the cylinder and the top circular face of the cylinder (the joined faces are hidden). With \(r = 1\) cm and \(h = 2\) cm, the total surface area is \(2\pi r^2 + 2\pi rh + \pi r^2 = 2\pi + 4\pi + \pi = 7\pi\) cm\(^2\), which is the choice \(7\pi\) cm\(^2\).
Q12.hi: खुले पृष्ठ हैं: अर्धगोले का वक्र पृष्ठ, बेलन का वक्र पृष्ठ और बेलन का ऊपरी वृत्तीय तल (जुड़े हुए तल ढके रहते हैं)। \(r = 1\) सेमी तथा \(h = 2\) सेमी लेने पर सम्पूर्ण पृष्ठ क्षेत्रफल \(2\pi r^2 + 2\pi rh + \pi r^2 = 2\pi + 4\pi + \pi = 7\pi\) सेमी\(^2\) है, जो विकल्प \(7\pi\) सेमी\(^2\) है।

Q13.en: Here the point \(E\) lies on \(AB\) and the point \(F\) on \(AC\). Since \(EF \parallel BC\), the Basic Proportionality Theorem gives \(\frac{AE}{EB} = \frac{AF}{FC}\), so \(AE = \frac{6.9 \times 1.7}{5.1} = \frac{6.9}{3} = 2.3\) cm, which is the choice 2.3 cm.
Q13.hi: यहाँ बिन्दु \(E\) भुजा \(AB\) पर तथा बिन्दु \(F\) भुजा \(AC\) पर है। चूँकि \(EF \parallel BC\), आधारभूत समानुपातिकता प्रमेय से \(\frac{AE}{EB} = \frac{AF}{FC}\), अतः \(AE = \frac{6.9 \times 1.7}{5.1} = \frac{6.9}{3} = 2.3\) सेमी, जो विकल्प 2.3 सेमी है।

Q14.en: The tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact, so the radius, the tangent and \(OP\) form a right triangle with hypotenuse \(OP\). Hence \(r = \sqrt{OP^2 - (\text{tangent})^2} = \sqrt{6.5^2 - 6^2} = \sqrt{42.25 - 36} = \sqrt{6.25} = 2.5\) cm, which is the choice 2.5 cm.
Q14.hi: स्पर्श बिन्दु पर स्पर्श रेखा त्रिज्या पर लम्ब होती है, अतः त्रिज्या, स्पर्श रेखा और \(OP\) एक समकोण त्रिभुज बनाते हैं जिसका कर्ण \(OP\) है। अतः \(r = \sqrt{OP^2 - (\text{स्पर्श रेखा})^2} = \sqrt{6.5^2 - 6^2} = \sqrt{42.25 - 36} = \sqrt{6.25} = 2.5\) सेमी, जो विकल्प 2.5 सेमी है।

Q15.en: Let the height of the tree and the length of its shadow both be \(h\). If the angle of elevation of the sun is \(\theta\), then \(\tan\theta = \frac{h}{h} = 1\), so \(\theta = 45^\circ\), which is the choice \(45^\circ\).
Q15.hi: माना पेड़ की ऊँचाई और उसकी छाया की लम्बाई दोनों \(h\) हैं। यदि सूर्य का उन्नयन कोण \(\theta\) है, तो \(\tan\theta = \frac{h}{h} = 1\), अतः \(\theta = 45^\circ\), जो विकल्प \(45^\circ\) है।

Q16.en: Use \(\tan 45^\circ = 1\), \(\sec 30^\circ = \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\) and \(\cos 0^\circ = 1\). The value is \(2(1)^2 + \left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^2 - 2(1)^2 = 2 + \frac{4}{3} - 2 = \frac{4}{3}\), which is the choice \(\frac{4}{3}\).

Q17.en: Set the polynomial equal to zero: \(x^2 - 5 = 0\) gives \(x^2 = 5\), so \(x = \pm\sqrt{5}\). The zeroes are \(\sqrt{5}\) and \(-\sqrt{5}\), which is the choice \(\pm\sqrt{5}\).
Q17.hi: बहुपद को शून्य के बराबर रखने पर \(x^2 - 5 = 0\), अर्थात् \(x^2 = 5\), अतः \(x = \pm\sqrt{5}\)। शून्यक \(\sqrt{5}\) और \(-\sqrt{5}\) हैं, जो विकल्प \(\pm\sqrt{5}\) है।

Q18.en: Let the greater angle be \(x\) and the smaller \(y\). Being supplementary, \(x + y = 180^\circ\), and \(x - y = 22^\circ\). Adding the two equations, \(2x = 202^\circ\), so \(x = 101^\circ\), which is the choice \(101^\circ\).
Q18.hi: माना बड़ा कोण \(x\) तथा छोटा कोण \(y\) है। सम्पूरक होने से \(x + y = 180^\circ\) तथा \(x - y = 22^\circ\)। दोनों समीकरणों को जोड़ने पर \(2x = 202^\circ\), अतः \(x = 101^\circ\), जो विकल्प \(101^\circ\) है।

Q19.en: Total frequency \(n = 6 + 8 + 7 + 10 + 5 = 36\), so \(\frac{n}{2} = 18\). The cumulative frequencies are 6, 14, 21, 31, 36. The first cumulative frequency greater than 18 is 21, which belongs to the class 20-30. So the median class is 20-30, which is the choice 20-30.

Q20.en: The largest sum two dice can show is \(6 + 6 = 12\), so a sum of 13 is an impossible event and its probability is 0, which is the choice 0.
Q20.hi: दो पासों पर अधिकतम योग \(6 + 6 = 12\) आ सकता है, अतः योग 13 आना एक असम्भव घटना है और इसकी प्रायिकता 0 है, जो विकल्प 0 है।

B1a.en:
By the mid-point formula, the mid-point of the segment joining \((-4, 2)\) and \((5, 6)\) is
\(\left(\frac{-4 + 5}{2}, \frac{2 + 6}{2}\right) = \left(\frac{1}{2}, 4\right)\).
This is given to be \(\left(\frac{x}{8}, 4\right)\), so
\(\frac{x}{8} = \frac{1}{2} \Rightarrow x = 4\).
Hence \(x = 4\).
B1a.hi:
मध्यबिन्दु सूत्र से, बिन्दुओं \((-4, 2)\) तथा \((5, 6)\) को जोड़ने वाले रेखाखण्ड का मध्यबिन्दु
\(\left(\frac{-4 + 5}{2}, \frac{2 + 6}{2}\right) = \left(\frac{1}{2}, 4\right)\) है।
दिया है कि यह \(\left(\frac{x}{8}, 4\right)\) है, अतः
\(\frac{x}{8} = \frac{1}{2} \Rightarrow x = 4\)।
अतः \(x = 4\)।

B1b.en:
Any point on the \(y\)-axis has the form \((0, y)\). It is equidistant from \((2, -5)\) and \((-2, 9)\), so by the distance formula
\((0 - 2)^2 + (y + 5)^2 = (0 + 2)^2 + (y - 9)^2\)
\(4 + y^2 + 10y + 25 = 4 + y^2 - 18y + 81\)
\(28y = 56 \Rightarrow y = 2\).
Hence the required point is \((0, 2)\).

B1c.en:
Side of the cube \(a = 5\) cm; radius of the hemisphere \(r = \frac{4.2}{2} = 2.1\) cm.
The hemisphere covers a circle of area \(\pi r^2\) on the top face, and adds its curved surface \(2\pi r^2\). So
Total surface area \(= 6a^2 - \pi r^2 + 2\pi r^2 = 6a^2 + \pi r^2\)
\(= 6 \times 25 + \frac{22}{7} \times 2.1 \times 2.1 = 150 + 13.86 = 163.86\) cm\(^2\).
Hence the total surface area of the block is 163.86 cm\(^2\).
B1c.hi:
घन की भुजा \(a = 5\) सेमी; अर्धगोले की त्रिज्या \(r = \frac{4.2}{2} = 2.1\) सेमी।
अर्धगोला ऊपरी तल के \(\pi r^2\) क्षेत्रफल के वृत्त को ढक लेता है और अपना वक्र पृष्ठ \(2\pi r^2\) जोड़ देता है। अतः
सम्पूर्ण पृष्ठ क्षेत्रफल \(= 6a^2 - \pi r^2 + 2\pi r^2 = 6a^2 + \pi r^2\)
\(= 6 \times 25 + \frac{22}{7} \times 2.1 \times 2.1 = 150 + 13.86 = 163.86\) सेमी\(^2\)।
अतः ब्लॉक का सम्पूर्ण पृष्ठ क्षेत्रफल 163.86 सेमी\(^2\) है।

B1d.en:
Make the cumulative frequency table:

| Class-interval | Frequency \(f\) | Cumulative frequency \(cf\) |
|---|---|---|
| 0-10 | 6 | 6 |
| 10-20 | 8 | 14 |
| 20-30 | 18 | 32 |
| 30-40 | 14 | 46 |
| 40-50 | 4 | 50 |

Here \(n = 50\), so \(\frac{n}{2} = 25\). The cumulative frequency just greater than 25 is 32, so the median class is 20-30.
So \(l = 20\), \(cf = 14\), \(f = 18\), \(h = 10\).
Median \(= l + \frac{\frac{n}{2} - cf}{f} \times h = 20 + \frac{25 - 14}{18} \times 10 = 20 + \frac{110}{18} = 20 + 6.11 = 26.11\) (approx.).
Hence the median is 26.11 (approx.).

B1e.en:
Suppose, to the contrary, that \(5 + \sqrt{3}\) is rational. Then we can write \(5 + \sqrt{3} = \frac{p}{q}\), where \(p\) and \(q\) are integers and \(q \neq 0\).
Then \(\sqrt{3} = \frac{p}{q} - 5 = \frac{p - 5q}{q}\).
Since \(p\) and \(q\) are integers, \(\frac{p - 5q}{q}\) is rational, so \(\sqrt{3}\) would be rational.
But \(\sqrt{3}\) is irrational. This contradiction arises from our wrong assumption that \(5 + \sqrt{3}\) is rational.
Hence \(5 + \sqrt{3}\) is an irrational number.
B1e.hi:
इसके विपरीत, माना कि \(5 + \sqrt{3}\) परिमेय है। तब हम \(5 + \sqrt{3} = \frac{p}{q}\) लिख सकते हैं, जहाँ \(p\) और \(q\) पूर्णांक हैं तथा \(q \neq 0\)।
तब \(\sqrt{3} = \frac{p}{q} - 5 = \frac{p - 5q}{q}\)।
चूँकि \(p\) और \(q\) पूर्णांक हैं, इसलिए \(\frac{p - 5q}{q}\) परिमेय है, अतः \(\sqrt{3}\) भी परिमेय होगा।
परन्तु \(\sqrt{3}\) अपरिमेय है। यह विरोधाभास हमारी इस गलत कल्पना के कारण है कि \(5 + \sqrt{3}\) परिमेय है।
अतः \(5 + \sqrt{3}\) एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।

B1f.en:
Write each number as a product of primes:
\(272 = 2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 17 = 2^4 \times 17\)
\(1032 = 2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 3 \times 43 = 2^3 \times 3 \times 43\)
HCF = product of the smallest powers of the common prime factors \(= 2^3 = 8\).
LCM = product of the greatest powers of all the prime factors \(= 2^4 \times 3 \times 17 \times 43 = 35088\).
Check: \(\text{HCF} \times \text{LCM} = 8 \times 35088 = 280704 = 272 \times 1032\).
Hence HCF = 8 and LCM = 35088.
B1f.hi:
प्रत्येक संख्या को अभाज्य गुणनखंडों के गुणनफल के रूप में लिखने पर:
\(272 = 2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 17 = 2^4 \times 17\)
\(1032 = 2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 3 \times 43 = 2^3 \times 3 \times 43\)
HCF = उभयनिष्ठ अभाज्य गुणनखंडों की सबसे छोटी घातों का गुणनफल \(= 2^3 = 8\)।
LCM = सभी अभाज्य गुणनखंडों की सबसे बड़ी घातों का गुणनफल \(= 2^4 \times 3 \times 17 \times 43 = 35088\)।
जाँच: \(\text{HCF} \times \text{LCM} = 8 \times 35088 = 280704 = 272 \times 1032\)।
अतः HCF = 8 तथा LCM = 35088।

B2a.en:
The greatest frequency is 21, in the class 30-40, so the modal class is 30-40.
Here \(l = 30\), \(f_1 = 21\) (modal class), \(f_0 = 17\) (class before), \(f_2 = 16\) (class after), \(h = 10\).
Mode \(= l + \frac{f_1 - f_0}{2f_1 - f_0 - f_2} \times h\)
\(= 30 + \frac{21 - 17}{42 - 17 - 16} \times 10 = 30 + \frac{4}{9} \times 10 = 30 + 4.44 = 34.44\) (approx.).
Hence the mode is 34.44 (approx.).

B2b.en:
Join \(OP\), \(OQ\) and \(OT\); let \(OT\) cut \(PQ\) at \(R\).
Tangents from an external point are equal, so \(TP = TQ\), and \(OT\) bisects \(\angle PTQ\). So \(\triangle TPR \cong \triangle TQR\) (SAS), which gives \(PR = RQ\) and \(\angle TRP = \angle TRQ = 90^\circ\). Thus \(OT \perp PQ\) and \(PR = \frac{8}{2} = 4\) cm.
In right \(\triangle ORP\): \(OR = \sqrt{OP^2 - PR^2} = \sqrt{25 - 16} = 3\) cm.
Let \(TR = y\) cm and \(TP = x\) cm.
In right \(\triangle TRP\): \(x^2 = y^2 + 16\). ...(1)
The radius is perpendicular to the tangent, so \(\angle OPT = 90^\circ\), and in right \(\triangle OPT\): \(OT^2 = TP^2 + OP^2\), that is \((y + 3)^2 = x^2 + 25\). ...(2)
Putting (1) in (2): \(y^2 + 6y + 9 = y^2 + 16 + 25\), so \(6y = 32\) and \(y = \frac{16}{3}\).
Then \(x^2 = \left(\frac{16}{3}\right)^2 + 16 = \frac{256}{9} + \frac{144}{9} = \frac{400}{9}\), so \(x = \frac{20}{3}\).
Hence \(TP = \frac{20}{3}\) cm \(\approx 6.67\) cm.
B2b.hi:
\(OP\), \(OQ\) तथा \(OT\) को मिलाइए; माना \(OT\), \(PQ\) को \(R\) पर काटती है।
बाह्य बिन्दु से खींची गई स्पर्श रेखाएँ बराबर होती हैं, अतः \(TP = TQ\), तथा \(OT\), \(\angle PTQ\) को समद्विभाजित करती है। अतः \(\triangle TPR \cong \triangle TQR\) (SAS), जिससे \(PR = RQ\) तथा \(\angle TRP = \angle TRQ = 90^\circ\)। अतः \(OT \perp PQ\) तथा \(PR = \frac{8}{2} = 4\) सेमी।
समकोण \(\triangle ORP\) में: \(OR = \sqrt{OP^2 - PR^2} = \sqrt{25 - 16} = 3\) सेमी।
माना \(TR = y\) सेमी तथा \(TP = x\) सेमी।
समकोण \(\triangle TRP\) में: \(x^2 = y^2 + 16\)। ...(1)
त्रिज्या स्पर्श रेखा पर लम्ब होती है, अतः \(\angle OPT = 90^\circ\), और समकोण \(\triangle OPT\) में: \(OT^2 = TP^2 + OP^2\), अर्थात् \((y + 3)^2 = x^2 + 25\)। ...(2)
(1) को (2) में रखने पर: \(y^2 + 6y + 9 = y^2 + 16 + 25\), अतः \(6y = 32\) और \(y = \frac{16}{3}\)।
तब \(x^2 = \left(\frac{16}{3}\right)^2 + 16 = \frac{256}{9} + \frac{144}{9} = \frac{400}{9}\), अतः \(x = \frac{20}{3}\)।
अतः \(TP = \frac{20}{3}\) सेमी \(\approx 6.67\) सेमी।

B2c.en:
Given: \(ABCD\) is a trapezium with \(AB \parallel DC\), and its diagonals \(AC\) and \(BD\) intersect at \(O\).
To prove: \(\frac{AO}{BO} = \frac{CO}{DO}\).
Proof: In \(\triangle AOB\) and \(\triangle COD\):
\(\angle OAB = \angle OCD\) (alternate angles, since \(AB \parallel DC\) and \(AC\) is a transversal)
\(\angle OBA = \angle ODC\) (alternate angles, since \(AB \parallel DC\) and \(BD\) is a transversal)
\(\angle AOB = \angle COD\) (vertically opposite angles)
So \(\triangle AOB \sim \triangle COD\) (AA similarity criterion).
The corresponding sides of similar triangles are proportional, so \(\frac{AO}{CO} = \frac{BO}{DO}\).
Rearranging, \(\frac{AO}{BO} = \frac{CO}{DO}\). Hence proved.
B2c.hi:
दिया है: \(ABCD\) एक समलम्ब है जिसमें \(AB \parallel DC\) तथा इसके विकर्ण \(AC\) और \(BD\) परस्पर \(O\) पर प्रतिच्छेद करते हैं।
सिद्ध करना है: \(\frac{AO}{BO} = \frac{CO}{DO}\)।
उपपत्ति: \(\triangle AOB\) और \(\triangle COD\) में:
\(\angle OAB = \angle OCD\) (एकान्तर कोण, क्योंकि \(AB \parallel DC\) तथा \(AC\) तिर्यक रेखा है)
\(\angle OBA = \angle ODC\) (एकान्तर कोण, क्योंकि \(AB \parallel DC\) तथा \(BD\) तिर्यक रेखा है)
\(\angle AOB = \angle COD\) (शीर्षाभिमुख कोण)
अतः \(\triangle AOB \sim \triangle COD\) (AA समरूपता कसौटी)।
समरूप त्रिभुजों की संगत भुजाएँ समानुपाती होती हैं, अतः \(\frac{AO}{CO} = \frac{BO}{DO}\)।
पुनर्व्यवस्थित करने पर \(\frac{AO}{BO} = \frac{CO}{DO}\)। इति सिद्धम्।

B2d.en:
Let the uniform speed of the train be \(x\) km/h. Time for 480 km \(= \frac{480}{x}\) h; at the reduced speed \((x - 8)\) km/h the time is \(\frac{480}{x - 8}\) h.
By the condition:
\(\frac{480}{x - 8} - \frac{480}{x} = 3\)
\(480 \cdot \frac{x - (x - 8)}{x(x - 8)} = 3 \Rightarrow \frac{3840}{x(x - 8)} = 3\)
\(x^2 - 8x = 1280 \Rightarrow x^2 - 8x - 1280 = 0\)
\(x^2 - 40x + 32x - 1280 = 0 \Rightarrow (x - 40)(x + 32) = 0\)
So \(x = 40\) or \(x = -32\). Speed cannot be negative, so \(x = 40\).
Hence the speed of the train is 40 km/h.

B2e.en:
Factorise by splitting the middle term. Here the product of the first and last coefficients is \(2 \times (-7) = -14\), and \(2\sqrt{7} \times (-\sqrt{7}) = -14\) with \(2\sqrt{7} - \sqrt{7} = \sqrt{7}\).
\(2x^2 + \sqrt{7}x - 7 = 0\)
\(2x^2 + 2\sqrt{7}x - \sqrt{7}x - 7 = 0\)
\(2x(x + \sqrt{7}) - \sqrt{7}(x + \sqrt{7}) = 0\)
\((x + \sqrt{7})(2x - \sqrt{7}) = 0\)
So \(x + \sqrt{7} = 0\) or \(2x - \sqrt{7} = 0\).
Hence \(x = -\sqrt{7}\) or \(x = \frac{\sqrt{7}}{2}\).
B2e.hi:
मध्य पद को विभक्त करके गुणनखंड करते हैं। यहाँ प्रथम और अन्तिम गुणांकों का गुणनफल \(2 \times (-7) = -14\) है, तथा \(2\sqrt{7} \times (-\sqrt{7}) = -14\) और \(2\sqrt{7} - \sqrt{7} = \sqrt{7}\)।
\(2x^2 + \sqrt{7}x - 7 = 0\)
\(2x^2 + 2\sqrt{7}x - \sqrt{7}x - 7 = 0\)
\(2x(x + \sqrt{7}) - \sqrt{7}(x + \sqrt{7}) = 0\)
\((x + \sqrt{7})(2x - \sqrt{7}) = 0\)
अतः \(x + \sqrt{7} = 0\) या \(2x - \sqrt{7} = 0\)।
अतः \(x = -\sqrt{7}\) या \(x = \frac{\sqrt{7}}{2}\)।

B2f.en:
Here the first term \(a = 8\), the common difference \(d = 3 - 8 = -5\) and \(n = 21\).
\(S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2a + (n - 1)d]\)
\(S_{21} = \frac{21}{2}[2 \times 8 + 20 \times (-5)] = \frac{21}{2}[16 - 100] = \frac{21}{2} \times (-84) = -882\).
Hence the sum of the first 21 terms is \(-882\).

B3b.en:
Let the fraction be \(\frac{x}{y}\).
First condition: \(\frac{x - 2}{y + 3} = \frac{1}{4}\), so \(4x - 8 = y + 3\), that is \(4x - y = 11\). ...(1)
Second condition: \(\frac{x + 6}{3y} = \frac{2}{3}\), so \(3x + 18 = 6y\), that is \(x - 2y = -6\). ...(2)
From (1), \(y = 4x - 11\). Putting this in (2):
\(x - 2(4x - 11) = -6 \Rightarrow x - 8x + 22 = -6 \Rightarrow -7x = -28 \Rightarrow x = 4\).
Then \(y = 4 \times 4 - 11 = 5\).
Check: \(\frac{4 - 2}{5 + 3} = \frac{2}{8} = \frac{1}{4}\) and \(\frac{4 + 6}{3 \times 5} = \frac{10}{15} = \frac{2}{3}\).
Hence the fraction is \(\frac{4}{5}\).

B4a.en:
Let \(PQ\) be the multistoried building of height \(h\) m, with top \(P\) and foot \(Q\), and let \(RS\) be the 10 m building, with top \(R\) and foot \(S\). Let the distance between the buildings be \(QS = x\) m. Draw \(RT \perp PQ\); then \(RT = QS = x\) m, \(TQ = RS = 10\) m and \(PT = (h - 10)\) m.
The angles of depression from \(P\) equal the angles of elevation at \(R\) and \(S\) (alternate angles), so \(\angle PRT = 30^\circ\) and \(\angle PSQ = 45^\circ\).
In right \(\triangle PQS\): \(\tan 45^\circ = \frac{PQ}{QS} = \frac{h}{x}\), so \(x = h\). ...(1)
In right \(\triangle PTR\): \(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{PT}{RT} = \frac{h - 10}{x}\), so \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{h - 10}{h}\) by (1).
\(h = \sqrt{3}h - 10\sqrt{3} \Rightarrow h(\sqrt{3} - 1) = 10\sqrt{3}\)
\(h = \frac{10\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{3} - 1} \times \frac{\sqrt{3} + 1}{\sqrt{3} + 1} = \frac{10\sqrt{3}(\sqrt{3} + 1)}{2} = 5(3 + \sqrt{3})\)
\(h = 15 + 5\sqrt{3} \approx 15 + 8.66 = 23.66\) m.
From (1), \(x = h\).
Hence the height of the multistoried building is \(5(3 + \sqrt{3})\) m \(\approx 23.66\) m, and the distance between the two buildings is also \(5(3 + \sqrt{3})\) m \(\approx 23.66\) m.
B4a.hi:
माना \(PQ\) बहुमंजिला भवन है जिसकी ऊँचाई \(h\) मी है, शिखर \(P\) तथा तल \(Q\) है, और \(RS\) 10 मी ऊँचा भवन है जिसका शिखर \(R\) तथा तल \(S\) है। माना दोनों भवनों के बीच की दूरी \(QS = x\) मी है। \(RT \perp PQ\) खींचिए; तब \(RT = QS = x\) मी, \(TQ = RS = 10\) मी तथा \(PT = (h - 10)\) मी।
\(P\) से अवनमन कोण, \(R\) और \(S\) पर बने उन्नयन कोणों के बराबर होते हैं (एकान्तर कोण), अतः \(\angle PRT = 30^\circ\) तथा \(\angle PSQ = 45^\circ\)।
समकोण \(\triangle PQS\) में: \(\tan 45^\circ = \frac{PQ}{QS} = \frac{h}{x}\), अतः \(x = h\)। ...(1)
समकोण \(\triangle PTR\) में: \(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{PT}{RT} = \frac{h - 10}{x}\), अतः (1) से \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{h - 10}{h}\)।
\(h = \sqrt{3}h - 10\sqrt{3} \Rightarrow h(\sqrt{3} - 1) = 10\sqrt{3}\)
\(h = \frac{10\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{3} - 1} \times \frac{\sqrt{3} + 1}{\sqrt{3} + 1} = \frac{10\sqrt{3}(\sqrt{3} + 1)}{2} = 5(3 + \sqrt{3})\)
\(h = 15 + 5\sqrt{3} \approx 15 + 8.66 = 23.66\) मी।
(1) से \(x = h\)।
अतः बहुमंजिले भवन की ऊँचाई \(5(3 + \sqrt{3})\) मी \(\approx 23.66\) मी है, तथा दोनों भवनों के बीच की दूरी भी \(5(3 + \sqrt{3})\) मी \(\approx 23.66\) मी है।

B4b.en:
Let \(PQ = h\) m be the pillar, with foot \(Q\) on the horizontal plane. When the sun's elevation is \(\phi\), let the shadow be \(QR = x\) m; when it becomes \(\theta\), the shadow is \(QS = (x + a)\) m, with \(R\) between \(Q\) and \(S\). (The shadow grows, so \(\theta < \phi\).)
In right \(\triangle PQR\): \(\tan\phi = \frac{h}{x}\), so \(x = h\cot\phi\). ...(1)
In right \(\triangle PQS\): \(\tan\theta = \frac{h}{x + a}\), so \(x + a = h\cot\theta\). ...(2)
Subtracting (1) from (2): \(a = h(\cot\theta - \cot\phi)\), so
\(h = \frac{a}{\cot\theta - \cot\phi} = \frac{a}{\frac{1}{\tan\theta} - \frac{1}{\tan\phi}} = \frac{a\tan\theta\tan\phi}{\tan\phi - \tan\theta}\).
Hence the height of the pillar is \(\frac{a\tan\theta\tan\phi}{\tan\phi - \tan\theta}\) m, that is \(\frac{a}{\cot\theta - \cot\phi}\) m.
B4b.hi:
माना \(PQ = h\) मी स्तम्भ है, जिसका पाद \(Q\) क्षैतिज तल पर है। जब सूर्य का उन्नयन कोण \(\phi\) है, तब माना छाया \(QR = x\) मी है; जब यह \(\theta\) हो जाता है, तब छाया \(QS = (x + a)\) मी है, जहाँ \(R\), \(Q\) और \(S\) के बीच है। (छाया बढ़ती है, अतः \(\theta < \phi\)।)
समकोण \(\triangle PQR\) में: \(\tan\phi = \frac{h}{x}\), अतः \(x = h\cot\phi\)। ...(1)
समकोण \(\triangle PQS\) में: \(\tan\theta = \frac{h}{x + a}\), अतः \(x + a = h\cot\theta\)। ...(2)
(2) में से (1) घटाने पर: \(a = h(\cot\theta - \cot\phi)\), अतः
\(h = \frac{a}{\cot\theta - \cot\phi} = \frac{a}{\frac{1}{\tan\theta} - \frac{1}{\tan\phi}} = \frac{a\tan\theta\tan\phi}{\tan\phi - \tan\theta}\)।
अतः स्तम्भ की ऊँचाई \(\frac{a\tan\theta\tan\phi}{\tan\phi - \tan\theta}\) मी, अर्थात् \(\frac{a}{\cot\theta - \cot\phi}\) मी है।

B5a.en:
**Note:** The English print says only "a larger hemisphere", while the Hindi print says the largest possible hemisphere (बड़े से बड़ा); the working follows the Hindi, which gives a definite answer.

The largest hemisphere that can be placed on a face of side 7 cm has diameter 7 cm, so its radius is \(r = \frac{7}{2} = 3.5\) cm. Side of the cube \(a = 7\) cm.
The hemisphere covers a circle of area \(\pi r^2\) on the top face and adds its curved surface \(2\pi r^2\). So
Surface area of the solid \(= 6a^2 - \pi r^2 + 2\pi r^2 = 6a^2 + \pi r^2\)
\(= 6 \times 7 \times 7 + \frac{22}{7} \times 3.5 \times 3.5 = 294 + 38.5 = 332.5\) cm\(^2\).
Hence the surface area of the solid is 332.5 cm\(^2\).
B5a.hi:
**टिप्पणी:** अंग्रेज़ी प्रश्न में केवल "a larger hemisphere" छपा है, जबकि हिंदी प्रश्न में बड़े से बड़ा अर्धगोला कहा गया है; हल हिंदी प्रश्न के अनुसार है, क्योंकि उसी से निश्चित उत्तर मिलता है।

7 सेमी भुजा वाले तल पर रखे जा सकने वाले बड़े से बड़े अर्धगोले का व्यास 7 सेमी होगा, अतः उसकी त्रिज्या \(r = \frac{7}{2} = 3.5\) सेमी है। घन की भुजा \(a = 7\) सेमी।
अर्धगोला ऊपरी तल के \(\pi r^2\) क्षेत्रफल के वृत्त को ढक लेता है और अपना वक्र पृष्ठ \(2\pi r^2\) जोड़ देता है। अतः
ठोस का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(= 6a^2 - \pi r^2 + 2\pi r^2 = 6a^2 + \pi r^2\)
\(= 6 \times 7 \times 7 + \frac{22}{7} \times 3.5 \times 3.5 = 294 + 38.5 = 332.5\) सेमी\(^2\)।
अतः इस प्रकार बने ठोस का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 332.5 सेमी\(^2\) है।

B5b.en:
Diameter of the capsule \(= 5\) mm, so the radius of the cylinder and of each hemisphere is \(r = 2.5\) mm.
Length of the cylindrical part \(h = 14 - 2r = 14 - 5 = 9\) mm.
Surface area = curved surface of the cylinder + curved surfaces of the two hemispheres
\(= 2\pi rh + 2 \times 2\pi r^2 = 2\pi r(h + 2r)\)
\(= 2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 2.5 \times (9 + 5) = 2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 2.5 \times 14 = 220\) mm\(^2\).
Hence the surface area of the capsule is 220 mm\(^2\).
B5b.hi:
कैप्सूल का व्यास \(= 5\) मिमी, अतः बेलन तथा प्रत्येक अर्धगोले की त्रिज्या \(r = 2.5\) मिमी है।
बेलनाकार भाग की लम्बाई \(h = 14 - 2r = 14 - 5 = 9\) मिमी।
पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = बेलन का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल + दोनों अर्धगोलों के वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल
\(= 2\pi rh + 2 \times 2\pi r^2 = 2\pi r(h + 2r)\)
\(= 2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 2.5 \times (9 + 5) = 2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 2.5 \times 14 = 220\) मिमी\(^2\)।
अतः कैप्सूल का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 220 मिमी\(^2\) है।

doubts.B5a: English prints "a larger hemisphere", Hindi prints बड़े से बड़ा (largest possible); solved as the largest possible hemisphere (diameter 7 cm), giving 332.5 cm2, with a note in both languages.
